status: open   priority: P2   area: ports   reported: 2026-09-08 by harbour-master

has the old limit and the planner keeps turning ships away. The maximum draft for
Rotterdam is now 24 m.

Acceptance:
  portByCode("NLRTM") reports maxDraftM 24; every other Rotterdam field and every other
  port are unchanged.

  registry/ports.csv
  src/ports/registry.ts
